# Engineer.ai

> Engineer.ai is a premium one-word .ai domain name that is for sale. To buy it, email team@coherence.com to make an offer.

## About the domain

- Exact-match keyword: "engineer", one of the most searched job titles and product categories in technology.
- One word, 8 letters, no hyphens or prefixes.
- The .ai extension is the standard address of the AI industry.
- Owned by Coherence (https://coherence.com). Site designed and built by QQuantum.ai (https://qquantum.ai).

## Use cases

- Autonomous AI software engineer: an agentic coding platform that plans, writes, tests and ships code.
- AI engineering talent marketplace: hiring vetted AI and machine-learning engineers, or AI-driven technical assessment.
- AI for civil, mechanical and electrical engineering: generative design, simulation, structural analysis, compliance.
- AI engineering education and certification: courses, bootcamps and credentials for AI engineers.
- AI engineering consultancy: designing and building AI systems for enterprises.
- DevOps, SRE and infrastructure agents: incident response, capacity planning, cloud cost optimisation.
- Robotics and hardware engineering AI: design, firmware and control software for robots, drones and embedded systems.
- Engineering knowledge and community: Q&A platform, newsletter, podcast or media brand.
- Engineering productivity analytics: measuring how engineering teams work from code, tickets and reviews.

## How to buy

- Email team@coherence.com to make an offer or ask about price.
- Once a price is agreed, payment is completed securely and the domain is transferred to the buyer's registrar account.
